page.heading: Skills
page.subtitle: Reusable instruction blocks. Bind them to an agent; their order is their order in the prompt.

empty.title: No skills yet
empty.body: Write one from scratch, or import a Markdown file or an archive.

selectPrompt.title: Select a skill
selectPrompt.body: Pick a skill on the left to read or edit it.

page.agentCount: {count, plural, =0 {No agents} one {# agent} other {# agents}}
page.deleteConfirm: Delete the skill “{name}”? Every agent using it loses it. This cannot be undone.

detail.disabledNote: disabled — no agent will receive it

create.title: Create a skill
create.subtitle: Name it and pick a type. You write the body next.
create.name: Name
create.starterBody:
# Rule

Describe what the agent must do.

editor.name: Name
editor.descriptionHint: This is the skill's interface — the one line an agent reads to decide the skill applies. Write it as an instruction, in the imperative: “Flag tests that assert on mock call counts instead of behaviour.” Not “about test quality”.
editor.descriptionPlaceholder: Flag every branch this diff adds that no test exercises.

body.label: Skill body (Markdown)
body.hint: Saving a changed body records a new version. A rename, a retype or the enabled toggle does not.
body.placeholder:
# Rule
Describe what the agent must do…

previewTab.promptHint: This is verbatim what is appended to the agent's prompt — as instructions, carrying the same weight as the agent's own system prompt.
previewTab.empty: This skill has no body yet.

versions.heading: Change history
versions.hint: Every body change is recorded. A restore appends a new version rather than rewriting the past.
versions.restoreConfirm: Restore the body from v{version}? It becomes the current body and is recorded as a new version — nothing in the history is lost.
versions.restoredToast: Restored the body from v{from} as v{version}

drawer.title: Import a skill
drawer.subtitle: From a Markdown file, an archive, or a URL

file.hint: Only Markdown is read from an archive. Scripts and binaries are never opened — you will see exactly what was skipped.

url.label: Skill URL
url.hint: Fetched by the server over https. Private and link-local addresses are refused.

import.evidenceCount: {count, plural, one {# Markdown file found} other {# Markdown files found}}
import.trustBody: A skill's text is added to the agent's prompt with the same standing as the agent's own system prompt — it is not quoted as data. Anything written here can redirect the review. Read it before you enable it.
import.savedToast: Imported “{name}”. It is disabled until you turn it on.

injection.title: This body tries to hijack the prompt
injection.body: A skill is added to the agent’s prompt as instructions, so text like this can override the review. The skill is kept so you can read it, but it cannot be enabled and will not reach any model.
injection.cannotEnable: Cannot be enabled while this is present
injection.limits: Pattern matching only — a rewording or another language can slip past it. Read the body; do not rely on this check.

stats.heading: What this skill has done
stats.hint: Counted from the runs of the agents that bind this skill right now. A run does not record which skills it used, so this attributes by current binding rather than by history.
stats.unused: No agent binds this skill yet, so there is nothing to count.
